vendor_id_collision_context._note: Toast also uses an integer order id; Toast's id space happens to overlap with Simphony's chkNum space. The canonical UNIQUE on (vendor_id, operator_id, vendor_entity_id, vendor_modified_at) namespaces by vendor_id, so the collision cannot reach the canonical write. The framework's idempotency_key shape ('vendor_id:operator_id:vendor_entity_id') prevents shadow-write across vendors.
